title: Jacques Vallée's control system: beings with us for thousands of years

tellings.quote: if you talk to Jacques Valle, he would say that they've been with us for thousands of years and they're sort of controlling like the earth in many ways

plain: Whatever lies behind UFOs has been with humanity for thousands of years and in many ways steers life on Earth, in the view Michels credits to Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher. Michels sums up this idea in his own words rather than quoting Vallée. If true, it would mean the phenomenon is not a recent visitor but a very old hidden influence on people.
